title: DBA in Human Resource Management (DBAHRM) in London 2027
longDescription: DBA in Human Resource Management (DBAHRM) This programme equips senior professionals with advanced knowledge in HR strategy, organizational behavior, and management. It emphasizes evidence-based decision-making, innovation, and strategic leadership. Participants learn to analyze complex business challenges and implement sustainable HR solutions. The DBA in HRM programme integrates advanced research, strategic management, and human resource practices to develop organizational leaders. Students explore innovation, entrepreneurship, and advanced business theories to address contemporary workforce challenges. Modules focus on applying theory to practice through case studies, research projects, and applied business analysis. The program fosters critical thinking, strategic decision-making, and evidence-based leadership in dynamic organizational contexts. Upon completion of the programme, students should be able to; Apply advanced research methods to evaluate HR strategies and organizational performance. Design and implement strategic HR interventions aligned with business objectives. Analyze organizational behavior to enhance leadership and team effectiveness. Integrate innovation and entrepreneurial thinking into HR and management practices. Critically apply advanced business theories to solve complex organizational challenges. Conduct strategic business analysis to support decision-making in HR contexts. Lead organizational change initiatives with ethical and sustainable practices. Translate research findings into actionable HR policies and interventions. Demonstrate advanced managerial competencies in dynamic business environments. Apply robust research methodologies in producing a thesis.
courseDetails:
The course is delivered in two segments. Segment 1 consists of Seven modules, each one with an assignment and Segment 2 consists of a RESEARCH REPORT(paper)Segment 1:

Modules: You will be awarded a level 8 Diploma for the completion of the coursework of the following modules.

Advanced Research Methods: Covers qualitative and quantitative research techniques for HR and management studies. Emphasis on data collection, analysis, and evidence-based decision-making. Prepares students to conduct applied research and evaluate HR interventions effectively.

Advanced Human Resource Management: Focuses on strategic HR practices, talent management, and workforce planning. Explores performance management, employee engagement, and HR policies aligned with organizational goals.

Strategic Management and Business Analysis: Develops skills to analyze competitive environments and organizational performance. Includes strategic planning, business modeling, and critical evaluation of management decisions.

Innovation and Entrepreneurship: Explores strategies to foster innovation within organizations. Covers entrepreneurial thinking, change management, and implementing creative solutions in HR and business contexts.

Advanced Business Theories: Examines contemporary management and organizational theories. Focus on applying theoretical frameworks to solve complex business and HR challenges.

Organizational Behaviour: Studies individual, group, and organizational dynamics. Topics include leadership, motivation, culture, teamwork, and conflict resolution in workplace settings.

Advanced Management: Focuses on strategic leadership, decision-making, and organizational governance. Prepares professionals to lead HR initiatives and manage change at senior levels.Segment 2 - RESEARCH/THESIS:

Here, you will produce an academic standard research report in this segment. This segment will last nominally for 10 to 12 Months. Your specialization depends on the topic you will select for the research.

modules.title: INNOVATION AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP
modules.summary: The course on Innovation and Entrepreneurship aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the principles, processes, and practices of innovation and entrepreneurship and how they can be applied to create value and solve complex problems in various contexts. Through theoretical concepts, case studies, and practical exercises, students will develop the skills and knowledge needed to identify, evaluate, and pursue new business opportunities and build and manage innovative ventures in a dynamic and rapidly changing global economy. Topics covered in the course may include ideation, creativity, design thinking, business model innovation, market analysis, financial modelling, risk management, and scaling. Students will also learn about the role of innovation and entrepreneurship in driving economic growth, job creation, and social impact and will explore the ethical and social responsibilities of entrepreneurs and innovators in today's interconnected world.

English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in the English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in the English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5 TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+) TOEIC Overall: 555+ PTE Overall: 50+ Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates: – Native English Speakers, OR; – Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR; – Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR; – 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.
workshops:

Weekly write-up webinars and monthly supervisor meetings will be held to offer better coordination between the student and the supervisor and achieve optimal professionalism in writing the research report.

INNOVATION AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP
The course on Innovation and Entrepreneurship aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the principles, processes, and practices of innovation and entrepreneurship and how they can be applied to create value and solve complex problems in various contexts. Through theoretical concepts, case studies, and practical exercises, students will develop the skills and knowledge needed to identify, evaluate, and pursue new business opportunities and build and manage innovative ventures in a dynamic and rapidly changing global economy. Topics covered in the course may include ideation, creativity, design thinking, business model innovation, market analysis, financial modelling, risk management, and scaling. Students will also learn about the role of innovation and entrepreneurship in driving economic growth, job creation, and social impact and will explore the ethical and social responsibilities of entrepreneurs and innovators in today's interconnected world.

blocks.text: Entry Requirements

Master’s or an equivalent recognized academic title in Business and Management. Master’s or an equivalent recognized academic title in any discipline with over five years of managerial and/or business experience. Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent recognized academic title in any discipline with over eight years of managerial and/or business experience.
English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in the English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in the English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5 TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+) TOEIC Overall: 555+ PTE Overall: 50+ Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates: – Native English Speakers, OR; – Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR; – Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR; – 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.
Workshops
Workshops are conducted through live webinars for online students.

Weekly write-up webinars and monthly supervisor meetings will be held to offer better coordination between the student and the supervisor and achieve optimal professionalism in writing the research report.
Visa Requirements
There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

Topics covered in the course may include ideation, creativity, design thinking, business model innovation, market analysis, financial modelling, risk management, and scaling. Students will also learn about the role of innovation and entrepreneurship in driving economic growth, job creation, and social impact and will explore the ethical and social responsibilities of entrepreneurs and innovators in today's interconnected world.

The course on Innovation and Entrepreneurship aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of the principles, processes, and practices of innovation and entrepreneurship and how they can be applied to create value and solve complex problems in various contexts. Through theoretical concepts, case studies, and practical exercises, students will develop the skills and knowledge needed to identify, evaluate, and pursue new business opportunities and build and manage innovative ventures in a dynamic and rapidly changing global economy. Topics covered in the course may include ideation, creativity, design thinking, business model innovation, market analysis, financial modelling, risk management, and scaling. title: DBA in Project Management (DBAPM) in London 2027
longDescription:
The DBA in Project Management is an advanced doctoral-level program designed to develop strategic leaders capable of managing complex projects across global organizations. The course integrates research, leadership, financial management, and strategic analysis to prepare professionals for high-level managerial and academic roles. It focuses on evidence-based decision-making, organizational effectiveness, and innovative project leadership. Graduates will gain the expertise required to drive large-scale projects and strategic initiatives in diverse industries.

This programme provides a comprehensive understanding of advanced project management practices combined with leadership, finance, and strategic management. It emphasizes the application of research methods to solve real-world organizational challenges and improve project outcomes. Through advanced study and applied research, professionals will enhance their ability to plan, execute, and evaluate complex projects. The program prepares learners for executive positions, consultancy roles, and academic research in project management and related disciplines.

Upon completion of the program, students should be able to;

Apply advanced research methods to analyse complex organisational and project management challenges.

Evaluate strategic management practices and their impact on organisational performance.

Develop effective project management strategies for planning, implementation, and control.

Analyse organisational behaviour and leadership approaches to improve team performance.

Apply global financial management principles to support strategic business decisions.

Design human resource strategies that support organisational growth and project success.

Integrate advanced management techniques to lead complex projects and organisational initiatives.

Critically assess business environments and develop strategic solutions for organisational challenges.

Demonstrate independent research skills and academic rigour in project management studies.
courseDetails:
The course is delivered in two segments. Segment 1 consists of Seven modules, each one with an assignment and Segment 2 consists of a RESEARCH REPORT(paper)Segment 1:

Modules: You will be awarded a level 8 Diploma for the completion of the coursework of the following modules.Advanced Research Methods develops skills in research design, data analysis, and academic investigation for organizational problem-solving. Advanced Human Resource Management focuses on strategic workforce planning, talent management, and leadership development within project environments. Strategic Management and Business Analysis explores strategic planning, competitive analysis, and decision-making frameworks used by senior managers. Global Financial Management examines financial planning, risk management, and international financial strategies. Organizational Behaviour studies leadership dynamics, employee motivation, and workplace culture. Advanced Management develops high-level leadership, governance, and managerial decision-making capabilities. Project Management focuses on planning, execution, monitoring, and successful delivery of complex projects across industries.Segment 2 - RESEARCH/THESIS:

Here, you will produce an academic standard research report in this segment. This segment will last nominally for 10 to 12 Months. Your specialization depends on the topic you will select for the research.
outcomes: Apply advanced research methods to analyse complex organisational and project management challenges.
Evaluate strategic management practices and their impact on organisational performance.
Develop effective project management strategies for planning, implementation, and control.
Analyse organisational behaviour and leadership approaches to improve team performance.
Apply global financial management principles to support strategic business decisions.
Design human resource strategies that support organisational growth and project success.
Integrate advanced management techniques to lead complex projects and organisational initiatives.
Critically assess business environments and develop strategic solutions for organisational challenges.
Demonstrate independent research skills and academic rigour in project management studies.

After successfully completing the course, you will be awarded a degree certificate and a transcript accredited by the European Institute of Management and Technology.

modules.title: GLOBAL FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The objective of this course is to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market risk, interest rate risk, and foreign exchange risk. This involves using futures and options.

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates: – Native English Speakers, OR; – Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR; – Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR; – 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.

The DBA in Project Management is an advanced doctoral-level program designed to develop strategic leaders capable of managing complex projects across global organizations. The course integrates research, leadership, financial management, and strategic analysis to prepare professionals for high-level managerial and academic roles. It focuses on evidence-based decision-making, organizational effectiveness, and innovative project leadership. Graduates will gain the expertise required to drive large-scale projects and strategic initiatives in diverse industries.

This programme provides a comprehensive understanding of advanced project management practices combined with leadership, finance, and strategic management. It emphasizes the application of research methods to solve real-world organizational challenges and improve project outcomes. Through advanced study and applied research, professionals will enhance their ability to plan, execute, and evaluate complex projects. The program prepares learners for executive positions, consultancy roles, and academic research in project management and related disciplines.
Upon completion of the program, students should be able to;
Apply advanced research methods to analyse complex organisational and project management challenges.
Evaluate strategic management practices and their impact on organisational performance.
Develop effective project management strategies for planning, implementation, and control.
Analyse organisational behaviour and leadership approaches to improve team performance.
Apply global financial management principles to support strategic business decisions.
Design human resource strategies that support organisational growth and project success.
Integrate advanced management techniques to lead complex projects and organisational initiatives.
Critically assess business environments and develop strategic solutions for organisational challenges.
Demonstrate independent research skills and academic rigour in project management studies.
Course Details
The course is delivered in two segments. Segment 1 consists of Seven modules, each one with an assignment and Segment 2 consists of a RESEARCH REPORT(paper)Segment 1:

Modules: You will be awarded a level 8 Diploma for the completion of the coursework of the following modules.Advanced Research Methods develops skills in research design, data analysis, and academic investigation for organizational problem-solving. Advanced Human Resource Management focuses on strategic workforce planning, talent management, and leadership development within project environments. Strategic Management and Business Analysis explores strategic planning, competitive analysis, and decision-making frameworks used by senior managers. Global Financial Management examines financial planning, risk management, and international financial strategies. Organizational Behaviour studies leadership dynamics, employee motivation, and workplace culture. Advanced Management develops high-level leadership, governance, and managerial decision-making capabilities. Project Management focuses on planning, execution, monitoring, and successful delivery of complex projects across industries.Segment 2 - RESEARCH/THESIS:

Here, you will produce an academic standard research report in this segment. This segment will last nominally for 10 to 12 Months. Your specialization depends on the topic you will select for the research.

After successfully completing the course, you will be awarded a degree certificate and a transcript accredited by the European Institute of Management and Technology.

GLOBAL FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT 5 Lectures 1 Quiz

The objective of this course is to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market risk, interest rate risk, and foreign exchange risk. This involves using futures and options.
Global Financial Management Landscape
Understanding Exchange Rate System
Understanding International Equity and Debt Markets
Understanding the Dynamics of Foreign Direct Investment
Country Risk Analysis, International Banking and Trade Finance

PROJECT MANAGEMENT 18 Lectures 1 Quiz

Project Management focuses on the planning, execution, and successful completion of projects within defined constraints such as time, cost, and scope. It introduces key methodologies, tools, and techniques used to manage projects effectively. The module covers project life cycles, risk management, resource allocation, and stakeholder communication. It also emphasizes leadership and teamwork skills essential for managing diverse project environments. By the end, learners will be able to plan, monitor, and deliver projects efficiently and professionally.

modules.title: GLOBAL FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The objective of this course is to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market risk, interest rate risk, and foreign exchange risk. This involves using futures and options.

English Proficiency Waivers:

Apply advanced research methods to analyse complex organisational and project management challenges.

Evaluate strategic management practices and their impact on organisational performance.

Develop effective project management strategies for planning, implementation, and control.

Analyse organisational behaviour and leadership approaches to improve team performance.

Apply global financial management principles to support strategic business decisions.

Design human resource strategies that support organisational growth and project success.

Integrate advanced management techniques to lead complex projects and organisational initiatives.

The DBA in Project Management is an advanced doctoral-level program designed to develop strategic leaders capable of managing complex projects across global organizations. The course integrates research, leadership, financial management, and strategic analysis to prepare professionals for high-level managerial and academic roles. It focuses on evidence-based decision-making, organizational effectiveness, and innovative project leadership. Graduates will gain the expertise required to drive large-scale projects and strategic initiatives in diverse industries.
This programme provides a comprehensive understanding of advanced project management practices combined with leadership, finance, and strategic management. It emphasizes the application of research methods to solve real-world organizational challenges and improve project outcomes. Through advanced study and applied research, professionals will enhance their ability to plan, execute, and evaluate complex projects. The program prepares learners for executive positions, consultancy roles, and academic research in project management and related disciplines.
Upon completion of the program, students should be able to;
Apply advanced research methods to analyse complex organisational and project management challenges.
Evaluate strategic management practices and their impact on organisational performance.
Develop effective project management strategies for planning, implementation, and control.
Analyse organisational behaviour and leadership approaches to improve team performance.
Apply global financial management principles to support strategic business decisions.
Design human resource strategies that support organisational growth and project success.
Integrate advanced management techniques to lead complex projects and organisational initiatives.
Critically assess business environments and develop strategic solutions for organisational challenges.
Demonstrate independent research skills and academic rigour in project management studies."},{"contentHash":"0faaea8a2327107724a85bfbe8866cde610c8812d7f26496791bb0981448d905","courseSlug":"dba-in-project-management","heading":"courseDetails","id":"chunk-6d2defabbcb3d82227d09a12","items":[{"text":"Course Details","type":"h4"},{"text":"The course is delivered in two segments. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market risk, interest rate risk, and foreign exchange risk. This involves using futures and options.

The objective of this course is to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market risk, interest rate risk, and foreign exchange risk. This involves using futures and options.

title: DBA in Supply Chain Management (DBASCM) in London 2027
longDescription:
The 180 ECTS credits Doctor of Business Administration (DBA) program aims to provide business students, managers, practitioners, and leaders with advanced knowledge, research, and analytical skills that they can apply to solve complex business problems. Unlike master's programs, the DBA program emphasizes the practical application of theory to real-world business challenges. Students are expected to undergo a transformative learning process that enhances their research skills, enabling them to approach business situations with a different perspective and a focus on applying research methods to find solutions that promote organizational efficiency, growth, and long-term sustainability.

The program is designed to be both flexible and rigorous, and it can be completed entirely online. Students have the freedom to set their own pace for completing the program. The duration of the program varies depending on the pathway the student selects (Coursework vs Research). While most students are expected to obtain the qualification within three years of enrolling, the research pathway may lead to a qualification in less than three years.

The MSBM DBA in Supply Chain Management program emphasizes applied research to enable executives, managers, and practitioners to apply what they learn in real-time in their organizations. The curriculum ensures that students acquire advanced knowledge and expertise in all business and supply chain management aspects. Coursework focuses on developing research, writing, presentation, critical and analytical thinking, and change management skills.

Upon completing the program, students can apply research methodologies to study business situations and solve business challenges. They will be able to conduct primary and secondary research to understand business challenges and apply a deep understanding of business and supply chain management fundamentals and practices to predict outcomes. Additionally, students will develop advanced proficiency in business communication, articulating complex ideas, strategies, plans, and tactics clearly and effectively. They will also be able to create meaningful reports using data collection, cleaning, interpretation, and visualization. Students will engage in academic and professional research activities that may lead to publications in peer-reviewed journals and develop high-level proficiency in applying robust research methodologies, study design, and study conduct to produce a thesis as part of the requirement for the conferring of the doctorate qualification. The MSBM DBA program offers both a coursework-based and research-based pathway for completion.
courseDetails:
The course is delivered in two segments. Segment 1 consists of Seven modules, each one with an assignment and Segment 2 consists of a RESEARCH REPORT(paper) Segment 1:

Modules: You will be awarded a level 8 Diploma for the completion of the coursework of the following modules.

ADVANCED RESEARCH METHODS:

This module will equip students with the qualitative and quantitative principles to undertake research at the doctorate level. The research principles will include a review of theoretical principles informed by Research Philosophy and Research Approach along with empirical research principles involving Research Strategy, Data Collection Method and Data Analysis Method. Additionally, students will be equipped to make appropriate judgements based on ethical practices during the PhD research.

ADVANCED HUMAN RESOURCE MANAGEMENT:

This module will aim at the management of human beings in a complex organisation; recruiting, selecting, training, promoting & motivating human beings. Increasing personal loyalties & managing personnel to elevate individual contribution, increasing quality & lowering operational costs.

STRATEGIC MANAGEMENT AND BUSINESS ANALYSIS:

The course presents conceptual frameworks and models which will assist students in analyzing competitive situations and strategic dilemmas and gaining insight into strategic management. This course will synthesise previous course materials within the business programmes. Lectures are supplemented with case studies.

ADVANCED BUSINESS THEORIES:

The course aims at helping PhD candidates develop an appreciation for the intellectual growth of business as a discipline. Students will have an opportunity to view the historical growth of the field from an economic to a behaviourally-based discipline. By studying multiple articles on each topic, students will gain an understanding of the way academic knowledge is developed, as well as be exposed to contemporary social science methods.

GLOBAL FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT:

This module aims to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market, interest rate, and foreign exchange risks. This involves using futures and options.

ORGANIZATIONAL BEHAVIOUR:

Theoretical statements of individual and group behaviour in organizations will be examined in this course. Student presentations and discussions will include detailed treatments of organization design, change, and reorganization, as well as inter-organizational relationships.

ADVANCED MANAGEMENT:

This module captures the essence of research in advanced theory and practice of business management that include areas such as Analysis of modern management theories, Development of organizations, Dynamics of organizational behaviour and relationship to effective administration in addition to the Models of communication, motivation, and leadership.

Segment 2 - RESEARCH/THESIS:

Here, you will produce an academic standard research report in this segment. This segment will last nominally for one-two year. Your specialization depends on the topic you will select for the research.

DBA in Supply Chain Management (DBASCM)

The 180 ECTS credits Doctor of Business Administration (DBA) program aims to provide business students, managers, practitioners, and leaders with advanced knowledge, research, and analytical skills that they can apply to solve complex business problems. Unlike master's programs, the DBA program emphasizes the practical application of theory to real-world business challenges. Students are expected to undergo a transformative learning process that enhances their research skills, enabling them to approach business situations with a different perspective and a focus on applying research methods to find solutions that promote organizational efficiency, growth, and long-term sustainability.

The program is designed to be both flexible and rigorous, and it can be completed entirely online. Students have the freedom to set their own pace for completing the program. The duration of the program varies depending on the pathway the student selects (Coursework vs Research). While most students are expected to obtain the qualification within three years of enrolling, the research pathway may lead to a qualification in less than three years.

The MSBM DBA in Supply Chain Management program emphasizes applied research to enable executives, managers, and practitioners to apply what they learn in real-time in their organizations. The curriculum ensures that students acquire advanced knowledge and expertise in all business and supply chain management aspects. Coursework focuses on developing research, writing, presentation, critical and analytical thinking, and change management skills.

Upon completing the program, students can apply research methodologies to study business situations and solve business challenges. They will be able to conduct primary and secondary research to understand business challenges and apply a deep understanding of business and supply chain management fundamentals and practices to predict outcomes. Additionally, students will develop advanced proficiency in business communication, articulating complex ideas, strategies, plans, and tactics clearly and effectively. They will also be able to create meaningful reports using data collection, cleaning, interpretation, and visualization. Students will engage in academic and professional research activities that may lead to publications in peer-reviewed journals and develop high-level proficiency in applying robust research methodologies, study design, and study conduct to produce a thesis as part of the requirement for the conferring of the doctorate qualification. The MSBM DBA program offers both a coursework-based and research-based pathway for completion.
Course Details
The course is delivered in two segments. Segment 1 consists of Seven modules, each one with an assignment and Segment 2 consists of a RESEARCH REPORT(paper) Segment 1:
Modules: You will be awarded a level 8 Diploma for the completion of the coursework of the following modules.
ADVANCED RESEARCH METHODS:

This module will equip students with the qualitative and quantitative principles to undertake research at the doctorate level. The research principles will include a review of theoretical principles informed by Research Philosophy and Research Approach along with empirical research principles involving Research Strategy, Data Collection Method and Data Analysis Method. Additionally, students will be equipped to make appropriate judgements based on ethical practices during the PhD research.
ADVANCED HUMAN RESOURCE MANAGEMENT:

This module will aim at the management of human beings in a complex organisation; recruiting, selecting, training, promoting & motivating human beings. Increasing personal loyalties & managing personnel to elevate individual contribution, increasing quality & lowering operational costs.
STRATEGIC MANAGEMENT AND BUSINESS ANALYSIS:

The course presents conceptual frameworks and models which will assist students in analyzing competitive situations and strategic dilemmas and gaining insight into strategic management. This course will synthesise previous course materials within the business programmes. Lectures are supplemented with case studies.
ADVANCED BUSINESS THEORIES:

The course aims at helping PhD candidates develop an appreciation for the intellectual growth of business as a discipline. Students will have an opportunity to view the historical growth of the field from an economic to a behaviourally-based discipline. By studying multiple articles on each topic, students will gain an understanding of the way academic knowledge is developed, as well as be exposed to contemporary social science methods.
GLOBAL FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT:

This module aims to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market, interest rate, and foreign exchange risks. This involves using futures and options.
ORGANIZATIONAL BEHAVIOUR:

Theoretical statements of individual and group behaviour in organizations will be examined in this course. Student presentations and discussions will include detailed treatments of organization design, change, and reorganization, as well as inter-organizational relationships.
ADVANCED MANAGEMENT:

This module captures the essence of research in advanced theory and practice of business management that include areas such as Analysis of modern management theories, Development of organizations, Dynamics of organizational behaviour and relationship to effective administration in addition to the Models of communication, motivation, and leadership.
Segment 2 - RESEARCH/THESIS:

Here, you will produce an academic standard research report in this segment. This segment will last nominally for one-two year. Your specialization depends on the topic you will select for the research.

modules.title: GLOBAL FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
modules.summary: The objective of this course is to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market risk, interest rate risk, and foreign exchange risk. This involves using futures and options.

English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in the English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in the English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+)TOEIC Overall: 555+PTE Overall: 50+Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates:– Native English Speakers, OR;– Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR;– Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR;– 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.
Workshops
Workshops are conducted through live webinars for online students.

Weekly write-up webinars and monthly supervisor meetings will be held to offer better coordination between the student and the supervisor and achieve optimal professionalism in writing the research report.

There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

Unlike master's programs, the DBA program emphasizes the practical application of theory to real-world business challenges. Students are expected to undergo a transformative learning process that enhances their research skills, enabling them to approach business situations with a different perspective and a focus on applying research methods to find solutions that promote organizational efficiency, growth, and long-term sustainability.","type":"p"},{"text":"The program is designed to be both flexible and rigorous, and it can be completed entirely online. Students have the freedom to set their own pace for completing the program. The duration of the program varies depending on the pathway the student selects (Coursework vs Research). While most students are expected to obtain the qualification within three years of enrolling, the research pathway may lead to a qualification in less than three years.","type":"p"},{"text":"The MSBM DBA in Supply Chain Management program emphasizes applied research to enable executives, managers, and practitioners to apply what they learn in real-time in their organizations. Coursework focuses on developing research, writing, presentation, critical and analytical thinking, and change management skills.","type":"p"},{"text":"Upon completing the program, students can apply research methodologies to study business situations and solve business challenges. They will be able to conduct primary and secondary research to understand business challenges and apply a deep understanding of business and supply chain management fundamentals and practices to predict outcomes. They will also be able to create meaningful reports using data collection, cleaning, interpretation, and visualization. Students will engage in academic and professional research activities that may lead to publications in peer-reviewed journals and develop high-level proficiency in applying robust research methodologies, study design, and study conduct to produce a thesis as part of the requirement for the conferring of the doctorate qualification. The 180 ECTS credits Doctor of Business Administration (DBA) program aims to provide business students, managers, practitioners, and leaders with advanced knowledge, research, and analytical skills that they can apply to solve complex business problems. Unlike master's programs, the DBA program emphasizes the practical application of theory to real-world business challenges. Students are expected to undergo a transformative learning process that enhances their research skills, enabling them to approach business situations with a different perspective and a focus on applying research methods to find solutions that promote organizational efficiency, growth, and long-term sustainability.
The program is designed to be both flexible and rigorous, and it can be completed entirely online. Students have the freedom to set their own pace for completing the program. The duration of the program varies depending on the pathway the student selects (Coursework vs Research). While most students are expected to obtain the qualification within three years of enrolling, the research pathway may lead to a qualification in less than three years.
The MSBM DBA in Supply Chain Management program emphasizes applied research to enable executives, managers, and practitioners to apply what they learn in real-time in their organizations. The curriculum ensures that students acquire advanced knowledge and expertise in all business and supply chain management aspects. The course is delivered in two segments. Segment 1 consists of Seven modules, each one with an assignment and Segment 2 consists of a RESEARCH REPORT(paper) Segment 1:
Modules: You will be awarded a level 8 Diploma for the completion of the coursework of the following modules.
ADVANCED RESEARCH METHODS:
This module will equip students with the qualitative and quantitative principles to undertake research at the doctorate level. The research principles will include a review of theoretical principles informed by Research Philosophy and Research Approach along with empirical research principles involving Research Strategy, Data Collection Method and Data Analysis Method. Additionally, students will be equipped to make appropriate judgements based on ethical practices during the PhD research.
ADVANCED HUMAN RESOURCE MANAGEMENT:
This module will aim at the management of human beings in a complex organisation; recruiting, selecting, training, promoting & motivating human beings. Increasing personal loyalties & managing personnel to elevate individual contribution, increasing quality & lowering operational costs.
STRATEGIC MANAGEMENT AND BUSINESS ANALYSIS:
The course presents conceptual frameworks and models which will assist students in analyzing competitive situations and strategic dilemmas and gaining insight into strategic management. This course will synthesise previous course materials within the business programmes. Lectures are supplemented with case studies.
ADVANCED BUSINESS THEORIES:
The course aims at helping PhD candidates develop an appreciation for the intellectual growth of business as a discipline. Students will have an opportunity to view the historical growth of the field from an economic to a behaviourally-based discipline. By studying multiple articles on each topic, students will gain an understanding of the way academic knowledge is developed, as well as be exposed to contemporary social science methods.

GLOBAL FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT 5 Lectures 1 Quiz The objective of this course is to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market risk, interest rate risk, and foreign exchange risk. This involves using futures and options. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market risk, interest rate risk, and foreign exchange risk. This involves using futures and options.

title: Doctor Of Philosophy (PhD) In Business Administration in London 2027
longDescription:
The 180 ECTS DBA in Business Administration program equips business students, managers, practitioners, and leaders with advanced knowledge, research capabilities, and analytical skills to address complex organizational challenges. Unlike other advanced programs, this DBA emphasizes the application of theoretical concepts to practical business issues, fostering transformative learning and enhanced research proficiency. Participants develop the ability to view business scenarios from innovative perspectives and apply research methodologies to devise solutions that promote organizational growth, efficiency, and long-term sustainability.

This flexible and rigorous program is delivered entirely online, allowing students to progress at their own pace. Depending on their chosen pathway—Coursework or Research—students typically complete the program within three years. However, research-focused candidates may achieve their qualification in less than three years.

The DBA program emphasizes applied research, enabling participants to implement their learning directly into their organizational contexts. The curriculum is designed to develop critical skills, including research proficiency, analytical thinking, effective communication, presentation techniques, and leadership in change management.

After completing the program, students will have the ability to:

Develop qualitative and quantitative research skills essential for doctoral-level investigations.

Apply effective strategies for managing human resources in complex organizational settings.

Analyze and address competitive challenges using strategic management frameworks.

Explore the evolution of business theories and their application to contemporary practices.

Master principles of asset valuation, risk diversification, and financial risk mitigation.

Evaluate individual and group behaviours to optimize organizational performance.

Enhance leadership, communication, and motivation skills for strategic management success.
courseDetails:
The course is delivered in two segments. Segment 1 consists of Seven modules, each one with an assignment and Segment 2 consists of a RESEARCH REPORT(paper) Segment 1:

Modules: You will be awarded a level 8 Diploma for the completion of the coursework of the following modules.

Advanced Research Methods:

This module equips students with essential qualitative and quantitative research principles for doctoral-level studies. It covers theoretical concepts such as research philosophy and approach, alongside practical methods like research strategy, data collection, and analysis. Ethical research practices are emphasized to ensure sound decision-making throughout the doctoral process.

Advanced Human Resource Management:Focused on managing human capital in complex organizations, this module covers recruitment, training, promotion, and motivation strategies. It aims to enhance individual contributions, foster employee loyalty, and improve operational efficiency while reducing costs.

Strategic Management and Business Analysis:This course offers frameworks and models for analyzing competitive challenges and strategic decisions. Integrating knowledge from previous modules and case studies, students gain a comprehensive understanding of strategic management and decision-making.

Advanced Business Theories:This module examines the intellectual evolution of business, transitioning from economics-based to behaviorally-driven approaches. Students engage with key articles and social science methods to understand the development of academic knowledge and contemporary research methodologies.

Global Financial Management:This module delves into asset valuation and financing principles in global financial markets. Topics include the time value of money, diversification and risk, and arbitrage and hedging, with practical applications in derivatives like bonds, stocks, and options. Risk mitigation strategies using financial instruments are also explored.

Organizational Behaviour:This module explores individual and group dynamics within organizations, focusing on organizational design, change, and inter-organizational relationships. Discussions and presentations highlight strategies for effective reorganization and behavior management.

Advanced Management:This module delves into advanced theories and practices in management, addressing organizational development, behavior dynamics, and leadership models. Students refine their understanding of communication, motivation, and strategic administration.

Segment 2 - RESEARCH/THESIS:

Here, you will produce an academic standard research report in this segment. This segment will last nominally for one-two year. Your specialization depends on the topic you will select for the research.

English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in the English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in the English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5 TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+) TOEIC Overall: 555+ PTE Overall: 50+ Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates: – Native English Speakers, OR; – Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR; – Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR; – 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.

blocks.text:
GLOBAL FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT
The objective of this course is to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market risk, interest rate risk, and foreign exchange risk. This involves using futures and options.
Global Financial Management Landscape 
Understanding Exchange Rate System 
Understanding International Equity and Debt Markets 
Understanding the Dynamics of Foreign Direct Investment

blocks.text: Entry Requirements

Master’s or an equivalent recognized academic title in Business and Management Master’s or an equivalent recognized academic title in any discipline with over five years of managerial and/or business experience Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent recognized academic title in any discipline with over eight years of managerial and/or business experience
English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in the English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in the English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5 TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+) TOEIC Overall: 555+ PTE Overall: 50+ Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates: – Native English Speakers, OR; – Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR; – Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR; – 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.
Workshops
Workshops are conducted through live webinars for online students.

Weekly write-up webinars and monthly supervisor meetings will be held to offer better coordination between the student and the supervisor and achieve optimal professionalism in writing the research report.
Visa Requirements
There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

Participants develop the ability to view business scenarios from innovative perspectives and apply research methodologies to devise solutions that promote organizational growth, efficiency, and long-term sustainability.

This flexible and rigorous program is delivered entirely online, allowing students to progress at their own pace. Depending on their chosen pathway—Coursework or Research—students typically complete the program within three years. However, research-focused candidates may achieve their qualification in less than three years.

The DBA program emphasizes applied research, enabling participants to implement their learning directly into their organizational contexts. The curriculum is designed to develop critical skills, including research proficiency, analytical thinking, effective communication, presentation techniques, and leadership in change management.

After completing the program, students will have the ability to:

Develop qualitative and quantitative research skills essential for doctoral-level investigations.

Apply effective strategies for managing human resources in complex organizational settings.

Analyze and address competitive challenges using strategic management frameworks.

Explore the evolution of business theories and their application to contemporary practices.

Master principles of asset valuation, risk diversification, and financial risk mitigation.

Evaluate individual and group behaviours to optimize organizational performance.

The objective of this course is to provide the principles of asset valuation and financing in competitive global financial markets. The course is organized around the three main ideas in Finance: The time value of money, Diversification and risk, Arbitrage and hedging. The time value of money is a basic determinant in the valuation of assets such as bonds, stocks, futures, and options. The classes on diversification and risk provide a thorough grounding in the trade-off between risk and return given by modern portfolio theory. In discussing arbitrage and hedging, we demonstrate how to hedge market risk, interest rate risk, and foreign exchange risk. This involves using futures and options.

The 180 ECTS DBA in Business Administration program equips business students, managers, practitioners, and leaders with advanced knowledge, research capabilities, and analytical skills to address complex organizational challenges. Unlike other advanced programs, this DBA emphasizes the application of theoretical concepts to practical business issues, fostering transformative learning and enhanced research proficiency. Participants develop the ability to view business scenarios from innovative perspectives and apply research methodologies to devise solutions that promote organizational growth, efficiency, and long-term sustainability.
This flexible and rigorous program is delivered entirely online, allowing students to progress at their own pace. Depending on their chosen pathway—Coursework or Research—students typically complete the program within three years. However, research-focused candidates may achieve their qualification in less than three years.
The DBA program emphasizes applied research, enabling participants to implement their learning directly into their organizational contexts. The curriculum is designed to develop critical skills, including research proficiency, analytical thinking, effective communication, presentation techniques, and leadership in change management.
After completing the program, students will have the ability to:
Develop qualitative and quantitative research skills essential for doctoral-level investigations.
Apply effective strategies for managing human resources in complex organizational settings.
Analyze and address competitive challenges using strategic management frameworks.
Explore the evolution of business theories and their application to contemporary practices.
Master principles of asset valuation, risk diversification, and financial risk mitigation.
Evaluate individual and group behaviours to optimize organizational performance.
Enhance leadership, communication, and motivation skills for strategic management success."},{"contentHash":"75fb2f84d575d1eabc96f353beb34c8915d9fb3186b826e5183cedfaf54bd34e","courseSlug":"dba-phd-in-business-administration","heading":"courseDetails","id":"chunk-8c8492def29bf0643374c5c0","items":[{"text":"Course Details","type":"h4"},{"text":"The course is delivered in two segments. The course is delivered in two segments. Segment 1 consists of Seven modules, each one with an assignment and Segment 2 consists of a RESEARCH REPORT(paper) Segment 1:
Modules: You will be awarded a level 8 Diploma for the completion of the coursework of the following modules.
Advanced Research Methods:
This module equips students with essential qualitative and quantitative research principles for doctoral-level studies. It covers theoretical concepts such as research philosophy and approach, alongside practical methods like research strategy, data collection, and analysis. Ethical research practices are emphasized to ensure sound decision-making throughout the doctoral process.
Advanced Human Resource Management:Focused on managing human capital in complex organizations, this module covers recruitment, training, promotion, and motivation strategies. It aims to enhance individual contributions, foster employee loyalty, and improve operational efficiency while reducing costs.
Strategic Management and Business Analysis:This course offers frameworks and models for analyzing competitive challenges and strategic decisions. Integrating knowledge from previous modules and case studies, students gain a comprehensive understanding of strategic management and decision-making.
Advanced Business Theories:This module examines the intellectual evolution of business, transitioning from economics-based to behaviorally-driven approaches. Students engage with key articles and social science methods to understand the development of academic knowledge and contemporary research methodologies.
Global Financial Management:This module delves into asset valuation and financing principles in global financial markets. Topics include the time value of money, diversification and risk, and arbitrage and hedging, with practical applications in derivatives like bonds, stocks, and options. Risk mitigation strategies using financial instruments are also explored.
Organizational Behaviour:This module explores individual and group dynamics within organizations, focusing on organizational design, change, and inter-organizational relationships. title: Doctoral Degree In Education in London 2027
longDescription: Doctoral Degree In Education The Doctoral Degree in Education equips learners with in-depth knowledge and analytical capabilities to address complex challenges in education and business. Participants explore advanced research methods alongside core disciplines such as contemporary education, financial, and marketing management. Graduates will be prepared to drive policy change, lead organisations, and contribute to academic and practical educational advancements. Upon completion of the program, students should be able to: Demonstrate the ability to design and apply qualitative and quantitative research methodologies to investigate complex issues in educational and business contexts. Critically analyse and evaluate contemporary issues in education within local, national, and global contexts. Evaluate and apply financial strategies to optimise educational institutions and organisations' budgeting, investment, and funding decisions. Develop and assess strategic marketing plans to promote educational services and address the needs of various stakeholders and learners. Critically examine ethical dilemmas and integrate socially responsible practices into organisational policies and leadership decisions. Analyse and interpret economic theories and policies to understand their impact on education systems and organisational sustainability. Apply leadership models to influence positive change, enhance team performance, and navigate complex challenges within educational institutions. Employ data-driven and ethical decision-making models to resolve strategic issues and improve operational efficiency in educational and business settings.
courseDetails:
The course is delivered in two segments. Segment 1 consists of eight modules, each one with an assignment and Segment 2 consists of a RESEARCH REPORT(paper)Segment 1:

Modules: You will be awarded a level 8 Diploma for the completion of the coursework of the following modules.Advanced Research Methods:This module develops advanced skills in formulating research questions, selecting methodologies, and analyzing data. Learners gain expertise in producing rigorous, evidence-based research to inform strategic decisions.Contemporary Issues In Education:This module focuses on critically examining current challenges, reforms, and innovations shaping education systems globally. It encourages learners to explore the social, political, and technological forces influencing educational theory, policy, and practice.Financial Management:Learners examine financial planning, investment analysis, and funding models within educational and non-profit institutions. The module covers budgeting, risk assessment, and financial performance metrics. It prepares learners to make sound fiscal decisions that align with long-term goals.Marketing Management:This module provides insights into market research, branding, and strategic communication in educational contexts. Learners will design campaigns tailored to institutional goals and learner needs.Business Ethics and Social Responsibility:Learners explore ethical theories, corporate responsibility, and stakeholder analysis in the education sector. The module fosters ethical awareness and promotes values-based governance.Economic Theory and Policy:The module examines classical and modern economic theories in the context of public policy and education systems. Learners analyze policy impacts on access, equity, and institutional funding.Leadership in Organizations:This module investigates transformational, transactional, and situational leadership frameworks. Learners assess how leadership styles influence culture, performance, and innovation.Managerial Decision Making:The module explores models of rational, bounded, and intuitive decision-making. Emphasis is placed on strategic, ethical, and collaborative approaches to solving problems.Segment 2 - RESEARCH/THESIS:

Here, you will produce an academic standard research report in this segment. This segment will last nominally for 10 to 12 Months. Your specialization depends on the topic you will select for the research.
outcomes: Demonstrate the ability to design and apply qualitative and quantitative research methodologies to investigate complex issues in educational and business contexts.
Critically analyse and evaluate contemporary issues in education within local, national, and global contexts.
Evaluate and apply financial strategies to optimise educational institutions and organisations' budgeting, investment, and funding decisions.
Develop and assess strategic marketing plans to promote educational services and address the needs of various stakeholders and learners.
Critically examine ethical dilemmas and integrate socially responsible practices into organisational policies and leadership decisions.
Analyse and interpret economic theories and policies to understand their impact on education systems and organisational sustainability.
Apply leadership models to influence positive change, enhance team performance, and navigate complex challenges within educational institutions.
Employ data-driven and ethical decision-making models to resolve strategic issues and improve operational efficiency in educational and business settings.

After successfully completing the course, you will be awarded a degree certificate and a transcript accredited by the Azteca University.

English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in the English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in the English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5 TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+) TOEIC Overall: 555+ PTE Overall: 50+ Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates: – Native English Speakers, OR; – Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR; – Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR; – 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.
workshops:

Weekly write-up webinars and monthly supervisor meetings will be held to offer better coordination between the student and the supervisor and achieve optimal professionalism in writing the research report.

Analyse and interpret economic theories and policies to understand their impact on education systems and organisational sustainability.
Apply leadership models to influence positive change, enhance team performance, and navigate complex challenges within educational institutions.
Employ data-driven and ethical decision-making models to resolve strategic issues and improve operational efficiency in educational and business settings.

English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in the English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in the English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5 TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+) TOEIC Overall: 555+ PTE Overall: 50+ Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates: – Native English Speakers, OR; – Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR; – Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR; – 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.
Workshops
Workshops are conducted through live webinars for online students.

Weekly write-up webinars and monthly supervisor meetings will be held to offer better coordination between the student and the supervisor and achieve optimal professionalism in writing the research report.
Visa Requirements
There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

title: Executive Master Of Business Administration in London 2027
longDescription:
The EMBA equips professionals with the tools to navigate dynamic markets and foster competitive advantage. Through strategic frameworks and leadership development, participants will enhance their ability to inspire teams, optimize resources, and implement effective organizational practices. The program emphasizes innovation, financial acumen, and data-driven solutions to address complex business challenges. Additionally, participants will refine their understanding of human behavior and organizational structures to drive operational efficiency and collaboration.

The MBA curriculum consists of at least 72 ECTS credits of postgraduate study, offered as modular fashion. MBA-candidates in the short programme complete 10 required modules/courses (60 ECTS credits), plus a final Thesis/Dissertation (12 ECTS credits) or 2 additional modules (6 ECTS credits each) all of these focused on a specific field or industry of management.
courseDetails: Course Details This programme integrates strategic management, leadership, financial planning, and marketing to foster organizational excellence. Participants will explore organizational theory, behavioural insights, and entrepreneurial innovation. By combining practical and theoretical approaches, this EMBA prepares leaders to adapt to global challenges and create impactful solutions. Students will emerge equipped to lead teams, manage resources, and drive sustainable growth. Upon the completion of the course, you will be able to learn the following: Develop the ability to assess and implement strategic frameworks that ensure organizational competitiveness and adaptability in changing markets. Develop leadership approaches that foster innovation, align team efforts, and drive long-term organizational success. Analyze HR policies and practices to foster employee engagement and ensure alignment with organizational goals. Apply strategic financial planning techniques to optimize investment and manage organizational financial resources. Design effective marketing strategies to build competitive advantage by leveraging market trends and consumer insights. Utilize advanced research techniques to investigate business challenges and create data-informed solutions. Develop the ability to analyze and implement key management principles to enhance organizational performance and competitiveness. Understand and evaluate key organizational structures and processes to improve efficiency and adaptability. Analyze human behaviour within organizations to foster teamwork, motivation, and a positive work environment. Develop creative and entrepreneurial strategies to drive innovation and create sustainable business ventures.

modules.summary: The thesis in EMBA allows students to conduct in-depth research on a strategic business topic, demonstrating their ability to apply advanced management concepts and frameworks to real-world organizational challenges.

entry: You are required to hold at minimum a recognised bachelor’s degree with a minimum overall score of 55% (GPA 2.0 on a 4.0 point scale) or higher.

In some instances, you may also require relevant work experience and/or research experience. If applicable, you may demonstrate this through the submission of a CV, portfolio, and/or a personal statement.
English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+)TOEIC Overall: 555+PTE Overall: 50+Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates:– Native English Speakers, OR;– Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR;– Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR;– 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.
workshops: Workshops Workshops are conducted through live webinars for online students.
visa: Visa Requirements There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

You are required to hold at minimum a recognised bachelor’s degree with a minimum overall score of 55% (GPA 2.0 on a 4.0 point scale) or higher.

In some instances, you may also require relevant work experience and/or research experience. If applicable, you may demonstrate this through the submission of a CV, portfolio, and/or a personal statement.
English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+)TOEIC Overall: 555+PTE Overall: 50+Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates:– Native English Speakers, OR;– Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR;– Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR;– 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.
Workshops
Workshops Workshops are conducted through live webinars for online students.
Visa Requirements
Visa Requirements There is no Visa requirement for this programme.

title: Executive Master Of Business Administration In Banking And Insurance in London 2027
longDescription:
The EMBA in Banking and Insurance equips professionals with advanced skills in strategic management, financial planning, and operational leadership. Participants will explore global banking regulations, commercial banking functions, and e-commerce technologies. The program emphasizes developing innovative strategies to enhance competitiveness, adaptability, and customer engagement in dynamic markets. Through applied research, students will address industry challenges and create sustainable solutions.

The MBA curriculum consists of at least 72 ECTS credits of postgraduate study, offered as modular fashion. MBA-candidates in the short programme complete 10 required modules/courses (60 ECTS credits), plus a final Thesis/Dissertation (12 ECTS credits) or 2 additional modules (6 ECTS credits each) all of these focused on a specific field or industry of management.
courseDetails: Course Details This program provides an in-depth understanding of banking regulations, commercial banking operations, and financial decision-making. Students will also learn to leverage e-commerce and advanced research techniques to drive innovation and improve service delivery. Leadership and marketing strategies are emphasized to foster long-term organizational success. The curriculum is designed to prepare professionals for leadership roles in banking and insurance. Upon the completion of the course, you will be able to learn the following: Develop the ability to assess and implement strategic frameworks that ensure organizational competitiveness and adaptability in changing markets. Develop leadership approaches that foster innovation, align team efforts, and drive long-term organizational success. Analyze HR policies and practices to foster employee engagement and ensure alignment with organizational goals. Apply strategic financial planning techniques to optimize investment and manage organizational financial resources. Design effective marketing strategies to build competitive advantage by leveraging market trends and consumer insights. Utilize advanced research techniques to investigate business challenges and create data-informed solutions. Understand key global banking regulations and their impact on financial institutions. Demonstrate knowledge of core functions and operations in commercial banking. Apply financial principles to analyze organizational performance and make informed decisions. Understand the principles and technologies driving e-commerce platforms.

Develop leadership approaches that foster innovation, align team efforts, and drive long-term organizational success.

entry: You are required to hold at minimum a recognised bachelor’s degree with a minimum overall score of 55% (GPA 2.0 on a 4.0 point scale) or higher.

In some instances, you may also require relevant work experience and/or research experience. If applicable, you may demonstrate this through the submission of a CV, portfolio, and/or a personal statement.
English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+)TOEIC Overall: 555+PTE Overall: 50+Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates:– Native English Speakers, OR;– Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR;– Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR;– 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.

blocks.text: Entry Requirements
You are required to hold at minimum a recognised bachelor’s degree with a minimum overall score of 55% (GPA 2.0 on a 4.0 point scale) or higher.

In some instances, you may also require relevant work experience and/or research experience. If applicable, you may demonstrate this through the submission of a CV, portfolio, and/or a personal statement.
English Language Proficiency:
Our programs are conducted in English language. As such, you must demonstrate proficiency in English language by submitting one of the following test scores during the application process:
IELTS Overall: 5.5TOEFL (iBT: 58+; PBT: 490+; CBT: 167+)TOEIC Overall: 555+PTE Overall: 50+Duolingo Overall: 90+
English Proficiency Waivers:

The English proficiency test is not required for the following candidates:– Native English Speakers, OR;– Applicants having completed their schooling in English (i.e. High School Diploma or IB), OR;– Applicants having completed their undergraduate or graduate studies in English, OR;– 2 years of work experience in an organization where English is the primary language of communication.

MBA-candidates in the short programme complete 10 required modules/courses (60 ECTS credits), plus a final Thesis/Dissertation (12 ECTS credits) or 2 additional modules (6 ECTS credits each) all of these focused on a specific field or industry of management.
